qiblaPathInfoTitle: How is the Qibla path calculated?
qiblaPathExplanation: This line shows the shortest path from your selected location to the Kaaba, calculated using the WGS84 model of the Earth. On a flat map, the path may appear curved, especially over long distances. Over shorter distances, it may look almost straight. The Qibla arrow shows the direction to follow at your location.

helpPage.title: How to use Qibla
helpPage.intro: Choose a tool and follow its step-by-step instructions.

camera.title: Find the Qibla with the camera
camera.start: Open the Camera page and tap "Start camera". Allow access to your camera.
camera.gps: Tap "Detect my location" and allow location access so the Qibla direction can be calculated.
camera.hold: Hold your phone upright and slowly turn in the indicated direction.
camera.confirm: When the camera points toward the Qibla, a green checkmark appears. The camera image freezes temporarily and your phone may vibrate.

compass.title: Find the Qibla with the compass
compass.gps: Open the Compass page and tap "Detect my location" to use your current position.
compass.hold: Keep your phone as level as possible and avoid tilting it too much.
compass.direction: Hold your phone flat and turn slowly until the green Qibla confirmation appears.
compass.accuracy: Keep your phone away from magnets and electronic interference. Accuracy depends on your device's sensors.

map.title: Find the Qibla with the map
map.gps: First, tap "Detect my location". Your current position will be detected and the Qibla arrow will appear on the map.
map.direction: The arrow shows you the Qibla direction from your current location.
map.path: For more details, enable "Show Qibla path". This lets you follow the direction toward the Kaaba on the map. You can also use the full-path option to display the entire path.
map.manual: If you prefer not to use GPS, you can select your location manually on the map or search for a city or address.

privacyPage.intro: Qibla helps you determine the prayer direction based on a selected location. This privacy notice applies to the website and the Android app. Qibla does not require a user account.
privacyPage.locationText: When you enable location detection, Qibla requests the relevant permission through your browser or Android. Latitude, longitude, and estimated accuracy are used to calculate the prayer direction locally and display the map. Automatically detected GPS coordinates are not sent to Geoapify as place search parameters. Location detection is optional. You can select a location manually instead.
privacyPage.storageText: Automatically detected location data, including its accuracy, is stored in sessionStorage. Manually selected locations, language, theme, and onboarding status are stored in localStorage. In the Android app, these storage mechanisms operate within the WebView. Local storage does not, by itself, transmit the saved values to a Qibla server.
privacyPage.searchTitle: 3. Place Search with Cloudflare and Geoapify
privacyPage.searchText: When you search for a place or address, your search text is forwarded to Geoapify through a Cloudflare endpoint. The Cloudflare Worker uses the IP address provided by Cloudflare to limit search requests. The shared daily counter does not store individual search profiles. Geoapify processes the search text and technical API request details. According to the provider, detailed data from successful requests is normally retained for no longer than 24 hours. In exceptional cases involving security or misuse, certain request details may be retained for up to two months.
privacyPage.tilesText: When you open the map, map tiles are requested directly from tile.openstreetmap.org. Your IP address and technical request information are therefore transmitted to the OpenStreetMap Foundation or its map infrastructure. Requested map areas may reveal which geographic region is being viewed. Light and dark modes use the same service. The OpenStreetMap Foundation provides further information about data processing and retention in its privacy policy.
privacyPage.hostingText: The Qibla website and search endpoint are delivered through Cloudflare. IP addresses, requested URLs, timestamps, and other technical connection information may be processed to provide the service, maintain security, and investigate errors. Cloudflare documents standard retention periods of three or seven days for enabled Workers Logs, depending on the plan. Other security and analytics data may be retained longer. Actual processing depends on the enabled Cloudflare services and account settings.
privacyPage.operatorText: The person responsible for Qibla and the contact for privacy requests:
privacyPage.paypalText: Qibla displays a PayPal link and a locally stored QR code for voluntary support. Simply displaying the QR code does not connect to PayPal. Only when you open the link or visit PayPal through the QR code may PayPal process personal information and payment details. PayPal's privacy information applies to processing carried out by PayPal.
privacyPage.retentionText: Automatically detected locations are generally retained in sessionStorage for the relevant session. Manually selected locations, language, theme, and onboarding status remain in localStorage until replaced or deleted. You can delete website data in your browser or clear local app data through Android settings. Camera and location permissions can be changed or revoked in the relevant browser or device settings. Retention by external services depends on their processing purposes and retention policies.
privacyPage.rightsText: Qibla does not create user accounts or store GPS location profiles on its own servers. Where personal data is processed, you have the applicable rights under the GDPR, including access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and objection. A right to data portability may also apply. You may lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For privacy requests, please use the email address above.
privacyPage.cameraSensorsText: Qibla requires camera permission for its augmented reality camera feature. The live camera image is processed locally on your device. When alignment is confirmed, the camera image may be briefly frozen. No permanent camera recordings are stored or transmitted to external servers. The compass and camera features also process available device orientation and tilt sensor data locally. Confirmation may trigger a vibration. Switching between the standard and Ramadan app icons is also performed locally based on a calendar calculation.
privacyPage.legalBasisTitle: 11. Legal Bases and International Data Transfers
privacyPage.legalBasisText: Technical service delivery, security, and user-requested features may be based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is to provide a functional and secure Qibla service. Accessing or storing information on your device is also subject to Section 25 of the German TDDDG, including the exception for operations strictly necessary to provide a service explicitly requested by the user. Cloudflare may process data outside the European Economic Area. Depending on the processing activity, recognized safeguards such as adequacy decisions and EU Standard Contractual Clauses may apply. Qibla does not use automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effects and does not create advertising profiles.

imprintPage.donationText: The money received will be passed on to people in need. None of it will be used for the developer's personal benefit.

qiblaFaqPage.intro: Find simple answers to common questions about the Qibla and the Kaaba.
qiblaFaqPage.meaningAnswer: The Qibla is the direction Muslims face during prayer. It points towards the Kaaba in Mecca.
qiblaFaqPage.unityQuestion: Why do Muslims face the same direction when praying?
qiblaFaqPage.unityAnswer: A shared prayer direction connects Muslims around the world. The Quran instructs Muslims to face the Sacred Mosque in Mecca (2:144).
qiblaFaqPage.worshipAnswer: No. Muslims worship God (Allah), not the Kaaba. The Kaaba serves as a common point of direction during prayer.
qiblaFaqPage.builderQuestion: Who built the Kaaba and when?
qiblaFaqPage.builderAnswer: According to the Quran, Abraham (Ibrahim) and his son Ishmael (Ismail) raised the foundations of the Kaaba (2:127). Its exact historical construction date is not known with certainty.
qiblaFaqPage.locationAnswer: The Kaaba is located inside the Sacred Mosque, al-Masjid al-Haram, in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.
qiblaFaqPage.calculationQuestion: How does Qibla calculate the prayer direction?
qiblaFaqPage.calculationAnswer: Qibla calculates the direction from the selected location to the Kaaba using the WGS84 Earth model. The arrow shows the prayer direction at that location.
